sql: select 'collector:'||kind as label, count(*)::text n, min(at)::text first_at, max(at)::text last_at, (array_agg(distinct left(coalesce(detail,''),110)))[1] sample from execution_collector_events where at > timestamptz '2026-09-17 12:13:00+00' group by kind union all select 'freshness:book_events', count(*)::text, min(received_at)::text, max(received_at)::text, 'now='||now()::text from execution_book_events where received_at > now() - interval '10 minutes' union all select 'freshness:queue_ticks', count(*)::text, min(captured_at)::text, max(captured_at)::text, '' from live_order_queue_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes' order by 1
